expires.description: Expires is when this resource expires (RFC3339).

labels.description: Labels are arbitrary key/value pairs attached to the resource.

namespace.description: Namespace is the resource namespace (usually left blank).

revision.description: Revision is used for optimistic concurrency control.

spec.description: Bot resource definition v1 from Teleport

max_session_ttl.description: The max session TTL value for the bot's internal role. Unless specified, bots may not request a value beyond the default maximum TTL of 12 hours. This value may not be larger than 7 days (168 hours).

roles.description: The roles that the bot should be able to impersonate.

traits.description: The traits that will be associated with the bot for the purposes of role templating.  Where multiple specified with the same name, these will be merged by the server.

name.description: The name of the trait. This is what allows the trait to be queried in role templates.

values.description: The values associated with the named trait.
